title: exploring generational diversity and aspirations in assam’s msme sector: a contemporary study of a tier-two city
core_idea: Investigate generational differences in work aspirations and job satisfaction among employees in Assam’s MSME sector (survey n=632) by applying quantitative techniques (exploratory factor analysis, hierarchical and k‑means clustering, and inferential tests) to characterize aspiration patterns and inform generationally sensitive HR strategies for regional MSMEs.
tldr: Survey-based quantitative study of 632 MSME employees in a tier-two city in Assam examining generational variation in work aspirations and job satisfaction using factor analysis, clustering, and regression to guide HR policy (no results reported).
